slice-ansi npm Package Compromised (Qix Account Takeover)

Target: slice-ansi
Repository: N/A
Date: 2025-09-08
Attribution: Third Party
Component: Library
Language: JavaScript
Cause: Social Engineering
Motive: Financial gain
Transitive: false
Impact Type: Financial Exploitation
User Impact: 50000000
Domain: npmjs.com (package host)
Artifact Type: source archive
Insertion Phase: distribution

Synopsis

Attackers executed a targeted phishing campaign against Josh Junon (Qix), a prolific npm maintainer, using a fake domain (npmjs.help). They intercepted his credentials and 2FA tokens, allowing them to publish malicious versions of this package. The malware included a crypto-clipper and a self-propagating worm that harvested cloud and GitHub tokens.

Compromised Versions

  • 7.1.1
